isDeprecated.description: Whether this Type, field, or method has been marked as [@deprecated](Ann.Deprecated).

newPkg.description: The new name of the {@link Pkg} for remixes.

newType.description:
The new name of a Type after a rename. Could potentially be empty if it was marked
as [@deprecated](Ann.Deprecated) but has an invalid or no link to a replacement.

newField.description:
The new name of a field or method after a rename. Could potentially be empty if it
was marked as [@deprecated](Ann.Deprecated) but has an invalid or no link to a replacement.

isGuessed.description:
If renamed, whether this rename was explicitly declared through {@link Ann.Deprecated#details}
or guessed with {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff#guessRevisions}.

title:
All relevant details associated with a Type, field, or method revision that are
used to inform various {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff.Metric}s.

A Type, field, or method is considered "revised" if it was deprecated, renamed, or both
between two {@link App} [versions](SemanticVersion). These changes are all stored on the
same Type because they're not mutually exclusive and because the results are collectively
used to inform the output of several {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff.Metric}s. For
example, if a Type was renamed, #isDeprecated determines whether the change was backwards
compatible.
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff.TypeMetaChangesBase.RevisionDetails
